address: 22, Lane 18, Jinhua Street, East District, Hsinchu City, Taiwan
bio: Dining out doesn't have to mean giving up on a wholesome diet. For the health conscious, min food has home-style sets that strike a nutritional balance – a protein course such as grilled Aussie beef tongue is served alongside soup, salad, pickles, multigrain rice, fruit and a small dessert. Portion sizes are adequate and every item is beautifully presented. There are a few à la carte items, but for the full experience, go for the sets.
